docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Sragdharā-stotra of the Kashmiri Buddhist poet Sarvajñamitra, a hymn to the goddess Tārā in the sragdharā metre, with a Sanskrit commentary and the editor’s introduction (Calcutta, 1908). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Sragdhara-stotram; or, A hymn to Tara in sragdhara metre, with the Sanskrit commentary of Jina Raksita, together with two Tibetan versions. Edited by Satis Chandra Vidyabhusana · Sarvajña Mitra, of Kashmir, Vidyabhusana, Satis Chandra, 1870-1920 · 1908, 318 scanned pages. Published 1908; Satis Chandra Vidyabhusana died 1920; the hymn is medieval; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the text of this book is in a script the machine reading of the scans cannot yet give.
